response.overview: DJ and music producer Deylin Malachi invites us into their world of music where he re-imagines and participates in the city's underground electronic DJ and music scene. Through him, we meet Songo Ananda, who alongside him embraces the legacy of authentic expression through electronic music as both a global and local phenomenon. Each testify to following one's own unique path and the joys of being part of a greater creative collective movement.
response.tagline: The buzzing cosmopolitan that is the City of Cape Town is home to new and emerging talent. Young artists push the boundaries of the sounds that shape nightlife and sonic expression in South Africa.
response.title: Where Are We Going Tonight?
